user_saw: Chat could show an unknown author’s message under the viewer’s name and avatar, and reply previews and Markdown exports could repeat the false attribution.
summary: The fix labels unattributed messages “Message” in chat, reply previews, and Markdown exports and removes their avatars.
reasoning: The oldest available source snapshot already used the viewer’s identity as the chat fallback and “You” in Markdown exports. The later sender-resolution and export changes retained those fallbacks, and the offline history lookup stopped at a missing object before I could establish when the assumption was introduced or first became wrong.
